answer: A Dedicated device bound by challenge-response signature with a public binding record ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone glacier cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. When the tundra settles over the summit, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
